jp.note: Japan approved miriplatin hydrate on October 16, 2009 for lipiodolization in hepatocellular carcinoma.

trials.role: Transarterial chemoembolization with miriplatin vs epirubicin for unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma
trials.outcome: Median overall survival was 1,111 vs 1,127 days. The trial did not show superiority for miriplatin (adjusted HR 1.01, 95% CI 0.73–1.40, p = 0.946). Grade ≥3 ALT elevations occurred in 31.5% vs 53.7% and AST elevations in 39.5% vs 57.7%.

trials.role: Hepatic arterial infusion of miriplatin vs zinostatin stimalamer in iodized oil for unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma
trials.outcome: At 3 months, 26.5% (22/83) vs 17.9% (7/39) achieved the primary endpoint (TE V: disappearance or complete necrosis of all treated tumors). RECIST response rates were 24.1% vs 25.6%.

trials.role: Hepatic arterial infusion of SM-11355 in Lipiodol
trials.outcome: 11 patients treated and 9 with PK measurements. The investigators did not reach the maximum allowable dose on the tested schedule.
